title: Official ballots with unavailable or ambiguous casting times
methodology: These published official presidential totals belong in an explicit untimed/unclassified bucket. They must not be assigned to before17:00,17:00–19:00,or after19:00 without validated cast timestamps. Not-installed sections are excluded.

sections.reason: Official BU/RDV/signature files are published, but the section metadata does not advertise a voting log. The bulletin confirms votes exist; their before/after split is unavailable from published voting logs.
